ops.title: roll: preserve the validated startup version as the watch baseline
ops.description:
Owner: desk-roll-on-install implementation caller.
Review scope: staged diff; source inspection only; no tests run.
Severity: major
Evidence: plugins/long-running/lr/internal/roll/roll.go:65 — After Watch validates the current target at line 34, follow rereads installed at line 65. A promotion between those reads becomes the new baseline and the post-registration changed callback cannot observe that the running version is old.
Next executable step: Capture the running pack version once and pass it to follow rather than rereading the current link for the baseline.

ops.text: A promotion between origin validation and watch registration is observed.
Repointing at the running version does not end the taking context.
